name: phil/browser-security-bundle
description: The protections a Symfony application asks of the browser, adjustable page by page: Content Security Policy with nonces, report-only and a bounded report endpoint, the neighbouring headers, HSTS and an HTTPS redirect, X-Frame-Options by path, signed cookies, external redirects refused, and Clear-Site-Data at logout

suggest.doctrine/dbal: For the violations kept in the table phil_csp_report
suggest.doctrine/orm: For the table added to the schema the ORM generates
suggest.phil/ip-anonymizer: For the client's address kept truncated with each violation
suggest.phil/rate-limit-bundle: To count the report bodies with a named limiter, beside the others of the application
suggest.psr/cache: For the deduplication of the events in a pool shared by the workers
suggest.psr/log: For the warning of an external redirect
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: For the nonce on the tags of importmap()
suggest.symfony/clock: For the clock service the reports are dated with
suggest.symfony/rate-limiter: For the throttle of the report endpoint, which the bundle refuses to build without unless it is disabled
suggest.symfony/twig-bridge: For the nonce on the tags of importmap()
suggest.symfony/web-profiler-bundle: For the profiler panel of the policy
